kind: 1語⇔複数語(正例)
canonical:
“Wait, it ends here!?” Have you ever blurted that out when a manga ends at an exciting moment and says the story will continue next time? What will that character say next? What will happen to the two of them? It might be a shame to let those ideas stay only in your head.

The company that runs LINE Manga has announced the launch of “byUs,” an AI story chat service. It is pronounced “bias.” You can enjoy talking with your favorite characters and make your own stories based on the works. You can take a step from the reader’s seat onto the stage of story-making.

If you thought, “Can’t you already talk with characters?” you’ve noticed something important. LINE Manga already has “Character Chat.” The company says the difference is that, as well as having conversations, you can make stories more freely. In other words, you can enjoy not only asking, “What should we talk about next?” but also, “What should happen next?”
asr: Wait, it ends here? Have you ever blurted that out? When a manga ends at an exciting moment and says the story will continue next time, what will that character say next? What will happen to the two of them? It might be a shame to let those ideas stay only in your head. The company that runs Line Manga has announced the launch of Buy Us, an AI story chat service. It is pronounced bias. You can enjoy talking with your favorite characters and make your own stories based on the works. You can take a step from the reader's seat onto.Stage of storymaking If you thought, can't you already talk with characters, you've noticed something important. Line Manga already has character chat, the company says. The difference is that as well as having conversations, you can make stories more freely. In other words, you can enjoy not only asking what should we talk about next, but also what should happen next.
label_basis: 音韻定義: byus=B AY1 AH0 S, buy us=B AY1+AH1 S(ストレス無視で一致)。ただしbyUs自体の公式発音は未確認(J7依存)

kind: 1語⇔複数語+他差分(Azure by us)
canonical:
Of course, you can’t bring in just anything you like. Only works and characters approved by their original creators can be used. The Help page also explains that the service has permission to use the original works it features through formal agreements with their creators. This is the foundation that lets you enjoy freely imagining “what if.”

The service first offered two works and four characters in Japan. “Taking part in a story” here means moving the story forward through conversation or making a story as a fan. The fun of reading a work is joined by the fun of thinking up what happens next.

Until now, “If it were me, I’d do it this way” was something you could only say to yourself. With byUs, those words become a way into making a story. What will you say to a character you love? What will happen next in the story? So, where will your “next part” begin?
asr: Of course, you can't bring in just anything you like. Only works and characters approved by their original creators can be used. The help page also explains that the service has permission to use the original works it features through formal agreements with their creators. This is the foundation that lets you enjoy freely imagining what if.The service first offered two works and four characters in Japan. Taking part in a story here means moving the story forward through conversation or making a story. As a fan. The fun of reading a work is joined by the fun of thinking up what happens next. Until now, if it were me, I'd do it this way with something you could only say to yourself. With by us, those words become away into making a story. What will you say to a character you love? What will happen next in the story? So where will your next part begin?
